incidents.name: Database slow down
incidents.message:
The issue has now been resolved

The root cause was the addition of database index, which had an unforseen impact. Only the EU region was impacted

incidents.name: We are experiencing database connectivity issues with Projects in our US region
incidents.message: Projects, Desk and Chat have returned to normal now. A projects database failed and was recovered quickly.  Chat took a little longer to return to normal due to a large number of re connections but has recovered fully now.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Database maintenance for Teamwork Desk - US region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are experiencing a slow down in Desk US region
We are currently experiencing log in issues in our US region
incidents.message: We had some emergency maintenance on one of our caches used by our log in system, it is recovered and back to normal now.

incidents.name: We are monitoring a database connectivity issue with a Desk database in our US region
incidents.message: A Desk database failed but was recovered quickly

incidents.name: We are currently investigating an issue with Tasks not loading on some Projects accounts
incidents.message: We have resolved an issue loading Tasks on some Projects accounts in the US region.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of log in issues in our US region
incidents.message: A Redis cache, responsible for storing logged in user sessions failed. It was recovered and we needed to restart some services in the US region to reconnect

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of Projects down time in the US region
incidents.message: One of our database replicas failed and was recovered causing Projects in the US region to experience an outage.

incidents.name: Chat US region cache issues
incidents.message: A Cache used by Chat in the US region needed to receive some maintenance earlier than planed. Chat log in issues are now resolved.

incidents.name: Investigating reports of 50X errors in the US region
incidents.message: Reports of reports of 50X erros have now been resolved. A number of services were restarted due to a Desk database failure earlier.

incidents.name: Desk Enterprise US region connection issues
incidents.message: Desk Enterprise US region connection issues are now resolved, a fault in the hardware caused the database to fail over to its standby in another region

incidents.name: Our teamwork.com blog is currently slow to load, we are working on this issue now
incidents.message: This issue is now resolved, our blog at https://blog.teamwork.com/ is loading quickly again now, sorry for any inconvenience

incidents.name: Investigating reports of errors with Projects and Desk, US region
incidents.message: We have resolved an incident which led to connectivity issues with Projects and Desk in our US region.

incidents.name: Intermittent issues loading Helpdocs in US region
incidents.message: Network requests are now completing.  Helpdocs response time back to < 200ms.

incidents.name: US Projects database connection issues
incidents.message: Teamwork Projects in the US region is now operating normally. A change to a database user caused the connection issues and has now been reverted.

incidents.name: Comments issue on Projects US region resolved
incidents.message: An intermittent issue preventing Comments from being posted on some accounts has now been resolved.

incidents.name: We are currently resolving an issue with our CDN for Desk in our US region
incidents.message: Desk US region is responding normally now. This was related to files served from a CDN which needed to be invalidated as part of a deployment to a new cluster.
